util/SouthAmpliaREST.md: REST client wrapper for issuing requests against the OpenGate South API.
util/_index.md: General-purpose helper classes: query expression builder, datastream field selector, and North/South Amplia REST client wrappers.
workgroups/WorkgroupFinder.md: Find a workgroup by domain and name through the OpenGate North API.
workgroups/WorkgroupRelations.md: Create and delete relations between a workgroup and a channel through the OpenGate North API.
workgroups/WorkgroupRelationsFinder.md: Find a workgroup relation by domain and name through the OpenGate North API.
workgroups/Workgroups.md: Build and update a workgroup, setting its name, description, domain and administrative flag, through the OpenGate North API.
workgroups/_index.md: Find, create and manage workgroups and their relations through the OpenGate North API.
